seo.title: Voice Easy — Private Voice Recorder for iOS
seo.description: Record voice memos and get instant on-device transcriptions. Your voice never leaves your device. No accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions.

hero.label: VOICE RECORDER
hero.title: Record and transcribe, privately.
text: Capture your thoughts with one tap. Get instant transcriptions that never leave your device. No accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

items.title: One-Tap Recording
items.text: Capture your thoughts instantly with our beautiful, oversized record button. See real-time waveform feedback as you speak.

items.title: On-Device Transcription
items.text: Your voice never leaves your iPhone. Voice Easy uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to transcribe your recordings locally. No internet required.

items.title: Folders & Tags
items.text: Create custom folders with icons and colors. Add tags to recordings. Keep everything organized exactly the way you want.

items.title: Full-Text Search
items.text: Find any recording by what was said. Powerful search through all your transcriptions finds exactly what you're looking for.

items.title: Variable Speed Playback
items.text: Listen at your own pace with 0.5x to 2x playback speed. Skip forward or back 15 seconds. Scrub through long recordings.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Record voice memos directly from your wrist. Perfect for quick notes when your iPhone isn't handy. Syncs automatically.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your voice stays with you.
text: Transcription happens entirely on your device using Apple's on-device speech recognition. No audio is ever sent to the cloud. No accounts. No tracking. No compromises.

cta.title: Start recording.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
